title: Ride application-guide template
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. Each ride needs its own application guide: ride class, approved RAS anchors or wrap members, required modules, tether angle check, exclusions (e.g. capsizable water rides, H27).
objective: Create a fill-in template plus one fully worked FICTIONAL example (a generic non-inverting coaster seat), clearly labelled fictional.
acceptanceCriteria: Template fields cover every REQ that is checked per ride
Worked example is fictional and says so; it names no real ride or manufacturer
Merged as DRAFT only; release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
